utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, we’re spreading the word for the repair drive—Jules is gathering names for tools, spare parts, and people who can lend time, and I’m waiting on Eli for the schedule and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I’m already checking who has screws, tape, batteries, and basic tools, so I’ll pass those names to Jules and wait for Eli’s schedule before telling folks where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Sam — I’ll let Jules know you’re checking on screws, tape, batteries, and basic tools, and I’ll send Eli’s schedule your way as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Rey—if you can quietly find out who has folding tables, bins, and extension cords, I’ll round up my tools and check in with Pia about the sign-up flow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that, Gus—I’ll ask around for folding tables, bins, and extension cords, and I’ll keep a simple list so we know what’s actually available.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Rey—if you send me that list when you’ve got a few names, I’ll match it against what I can bring and make sure Pia knows what gaps are left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Eli, I’m updating the repair drive supply list—do you know if anyone has confirmed batteries, basic tools, tape, or spare screws yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Cleo, I know Rey is asking around about needs and tools, and I’m planning to keep the list sorted from 10 to noon with Faye and Mara. I haven’t heard firm confirmations on batteries, tape, or spare screws yet, so I’d mark those as still needed for now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli — I’ll mark batteries, tape, and spare screws as still needed, and note that you, Faye, and Mara are covering list sorting from 10 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — arriving a little before 10 sounds perfect. I’m a bit scattered, but I’ll let Mara know to expect you for setup and the full window.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — I’ll be there just before 10 and stay until noon. If Mara needs me to bring anything for setup, just have her text me before school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — I’ll pass that along to Mara, and if she thinks of any setup supplies before your school drop-off window, I’ll ask her to text you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Uli — I’m still confirming the repair list and signup sheet, but the urgent items so far are Mrs. Park’s loose porch rail and leaking gutter.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana. I’ll point folks toward those first and keep the rest quiet until your signup sheet is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — please just tell them those are the likely first repairs, not assignments yet. I’ll circle back once I’ve confirmed who’s signed up and what supplies are promised.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, I’m trying to connect the folks who want to help without getting ahead of what we actually have—do you know anyone who can bring tools, spare parts, or a couple hours for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late jumping in. I promised Bo I’d ask around this afternoon, so I’ll check my block for screwdrivers, pliers, spare bits, maybe a soldering iron, and anyone who can spare a couple hours.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane—that’s exactly the kind of list Vik was hoping for. If you hear back, send me names and what they can bring, and I’ll keep it lined up with Pia’s check-in plan so we don’t crowd the room.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Mina, I’m still catching up while I’m out—have you heard what the repair drive needs most right now, or anyone I should point Jules toward?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, Ira—I’m still waiting on Nell or Hana for the actual repair list and start time. Tell Jules to hold tight unless they can bring basic hand tools and be flexible.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—that’s exactly the kind of update I needed. I’ll tell Jules to hold tight for Nell or Hana’s list, and mention basic hand tools if anyone’s eager to help now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, I’m glad you’re here—can you help me think through labels and pickup slips so we don’t lose track of whose repair is whose?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Pia—I’ll set up labels with name, item, phone number, and drop-off spot, plus matching pickup slips with the same number. Let’s keep the master list at the community room table so every repair gets checked in and out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds sensible, Opal—could we also use bright tape or numbered tags on the actual items, just in case a slip gets separated from a chair leg or toaster?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Nell, before I tell Sam or anyone else, can you confirm the exact date, time, location, and whether the community center is actually organizing it or just helping out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can’t confirm that yet, Kira—I’ve only heard second-hand that names and urgent repairs are still being sorted. I’ll check with whoever’s officially coordinating before you pass anything to Sam.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Nell—please let me know once you’ve confirmed who’s actually coordinating and the exact details, because I don’t want to send Sam the wrong information.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, I’m still waiting on Gus to confirm the exact kickoff from the community board, but the drive’s for fixing small household items, bikes, and appliances at the community center. So far I’ve only heard Gus is bringing his tool chest and spare fasteners—batteries are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks Tess—I’ll note small household stuff, bikes, appliances, Gus’s tools and fasteners, plus batteries still needed. Once the exact kickoff and fuller repair list come in, I’ll fold it all together and ping folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Bo—thank you. I’ll nudge Gus again and let you know the moment the kickoff time and any extra repair categories are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—would you like me to add you to the invite list, or do you know anyone nearby who might want to bring something or help out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn. Add Mara and Oren for sure—Oren’s helping on the day, and we still need folks with ladders, gutter tools, and basic rail-repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll add Mara and Oren, and I’ll spread the word that we’re looking for ladders, gutter tools, and basic rail-repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—that’s a huge help. Please send me the item list and tool volunteers as they come in, and I’ll match them into categories for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll send you the repairable-item list and tool volunteers in category batches as they come in. I’ll make sure everything is clearly marked for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara—thank you. I’ll keep the community room sorted by category so we can plug each batch in smoothly for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Nell, I’m helping Mara with the repair drive from 10 to noon, between school runs. If you’re stopping by, Eli’s helping keep the repair list sorted, so we should be able to point folks where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye—that helps a lot. I’d heard small appliances and bikes might be the main things, so I’ll check in with Eli when I stop by and pass the 10-to-noon window along carefully.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell—that’s perfect. I’ll be there a little before 10 to help Mara set up, so if you hear of any urgent repairs before then, send them our way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, with the community room as our main drop-off. I’m keeping the lists organized, so if you hear what folks are bringing or can volunteer, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—that helps, but can we confirm where overflow items go and who’s staffing the two check-in spots so the community room doesn’t bottleneck?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good thinking, Pia—overflow should go to the side hallway by the community room, and I’ll confirm the two check-in staffing slots today before we share the final note.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, before I share anything, can you confirm who’s actually organizing the repair drive and the exact time and meeting spot?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: From what I’ve heard, Jules is coordinating the matching of tools, supplies, and volunteers, but I don’t have the exact time or meeting spot yet—Vik said Eli should be posting those details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira—so Jules is coordinating volunteers and supplies, but the time and meeting spot are still unconfirmed until Eli posts them, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Vik. We’re still gathering small repair requests and matching them with folks who have tools or time; I can check the notice board and pass you the exact sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Uli—if you can grab the notice board details, I’ll pass them along to Jules and Ira and keep sending repair requests your way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll check the board quietly this afternoon and send you the exact details so Jules and Ira get the right information.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I’m helping coordinate supplies for the repair drive—do you happen to have spare screws, tape, batteries, or basic tools we could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I’m a little late getting my own tool list together, but I can check this afternoon for screwdrivers, pliers, tape, screws, and maybe a soldering iron. I’ll send you whatever I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane, that’d be a huge help—just send me whatever you find this afternoon, and I’ll add it to Cleo’s supply list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Leo, I’m putting together the repair drive supply list—do you know if anyone has confirmed batteries, basic tools, or other supplies yet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet—Oren’s confirmed to help, but I don’t have batteries or tools promised. Please list basic tools and batteries as still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Leo — I’ll mark Oren as confirmed to help, and keep batteries and basic tools listed as still needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Mina, I’m keeping the repair drive list tidy—can you tell me what you’re bringing and whether you’re dropping it at the community room?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, I can’t commit tools yet until Nell or Hana confirms the start time and urgent repair list—do you have either of those on your sheet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not confirmed yet, Mina—I have the community room as the tentative drop-off, but I’m still waiting on the start time and urgent list from Nell or Hana. I’ll mark your tools as pending and update you as soon as I hear definite details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Rey, sorry to ask, but have you heard where the repair drive is supposed to be? Sam was checking with Cleo or Kira, and I’m trying not to lose the thread again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard a firm spot yet, Oren — only that folks are still sorting the basics. I can quietly ask Sam or Cleo next time I see them and pass it back to you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey, I’d appreciate that. If you hear from Sam or Cleo, could you maybe tell me twice—or make me write it down?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, I’m still waiting on the exact kickoff time, but I’m checking the community board and bringing my tool chest with spare fasteners. If you hear Pia needs bins, tables, or help keeping sign-ups tidy, send her my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus—that tool chest and spare fasteners will be a big help. I’ll point Pia your way for bins, tables, or sign-up wrangling once the kickoff time firms up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Jules—once I check the board, I’ll let you and Pia know the time. I’ll also round up a couple folding tables and some labeled bins just in case.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mara, I may be a bit behind, but Faye says she can come just before 10 and stay through noon to help set up. Cleo’s checking on supplies too, so I think the urgent repairs list is the main thing to pin down.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah—that helps a lot. I’ll mark Faye for setup just before 10 through noon, note Cleo on supplies, and keep the urgent list focused on the porch rail and Mrs. Park’s gutter first unless you hear of anything more pressing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds right to me, Mara—porch rail and Mrs. Park’s gutter are the only urgent ones I’ve heard about so far. I’ll tell you if Cleo confirms anything useful on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Quinn, the plan as I understand it is Saturday from 10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating; I’ll help keep the repair list organized so people know where to go and what tools are needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli—thanks for keeping the repair list organized. I’ll spread Saturday 10 to noon with Faye and Mara coordinating, and I’ll point folks your way for tools and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Quinn—thank you. If folks can bring the item, note what’s wrong, and mention any tools they can lend, I’ll keep the list tidy Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Bo — I’m checking the repair list and signup sheet before assigning anything; so far Leo named Mrs. Park’s loose porch rail and leaking gutter as urgent, but I still need to confirm who’s signed up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks Hana — I’ve only skimmed the repair list so far, mostly small appliances and bikes, but yes, Leo’s porch rail/gutter note sounds like the urgent one to flag. I’m still waiting on the fuller list before we assign folks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep the porch rail and gutter flagged as urgent, but I won’t assign anyone until we have the full list and confirmed signups.
